svg.title: tsrs vs bun check vs tsgo
svg.desc: Summed over 17 TypeScript projects · 4 threads each · 16-vCPU Linux machine. Check time: tsrs 12.5 s, bun check 37.5 s, tsgo 82.2 s. Peak memory: tsrs 12.6 GiB, bun check 15.3 GiB, tsgo 53.6 GiB. Shorter is better. Per project: vscode: tsrs 2.21 s, 1.80 GiB; bun check 4.36 s, 1.50 GiB; tsgo 10.66 s, 7.51 GiB. xstate-main: tsrs 0.16 s, 0.25 GiB; bun check 0.31 s, 0.30 GiB; tsgo 0.85 s, 0.72 GiB. webpack: tsrs 0.28 s, 0.40 GiB; bun check 0.52 s, 0.37 GiB; tsgo 1.37 s, 1.17 GiB. mui-docs: tsrs 1.13 s, 1.05 GiB; bun check 10.04 s, 5.31 GiB; tsgo 13.32 s, 7.66 GiB. Compiler: tsrs 0.07 s, 0.10 GiB; bun check 0.11 s, 0.12 GiB; tsgo 0.29 s, 0.21 GiB. Compiler-Unions: tsrs 0.10 s, 0.10 GiB; bun check 0.23 s, 0.13 GiB; tsgo 0.58 s, 0.23 GiB. cal-diy: tsrs 1.01 s, 1.15 GiB; bun check 3.06 s, 0.92 GiB; tsgo 5.54 s, 4.29 GiB. formbricks-web: tsrs 1.31 s, 1.45 GiB; bun check 2.70 s, 1.34 GiB; tsgo 7.49 s, 5.85 GiB. supabase-studio: tsrs 1.19 s, 1.19 GiB; bun check 3.46 s, 0.89 GiB; tsgo 6.58 s, 4.85 GiB. t3code-server: tsrs 1.68 s, 1.17 GiB; bun check 3.81 s, 1.03 GiB; tsgo 14.51 s, 6.12 GiB. mikro-orm: tsrs 1.55 s, 1.37 GiB; bun check 4.83 s, 0.76 GiB; tsgo 10.31 s, 6.60 GiB. next-packages-next: tsrs 0.47 s, 0.55 GiB; bun check 0.98 s, 0.50 GiB; tsgo 3.19 s, 1.78 GiB. next-root: tsrs 0.29 s, 0.40 GiB; bun check 0.60 s, 0.42 GiB; tsgo 1.52 s, 1.30 GiB. storybook: tsrs 0.29 s, 0.39 GiB; bun check 0.57 s, 0.44 GiB; tsgo 1.76 s, 1.37 GiB. nuxt: tsrs 0.24 s, 0.38 GiB; bun check 0.68 s, 0.40 GiB; tsgo 1.25 s, 1.14 GiB. playwright: tsrs 0.24 s, 0.34 GiB; bun check 0.48 s, 0.37 GiB; tsgo 1.23 s, 1.05 GiB. drizzle-orm: tsrs 0.28 s, 0.50 GiB; bun check 0.77 s, 0.53 GiB; tsgo 1.77 s, 1.72 GiB. tsgo and tsrs with --checkers 4, bun check with --threads 4. Median of 10 interleaved runs (3 for tsgo). tsrs uses PGO-optimized dist build, built like the npm release binaries. Machine: Depot CI depot-ubuntu-24.04-16 (16 vCPU, 63 GB RAM, Linux x86_64, AMD EPYC 9R45 96-Core Processor). Measured 2026-10-15 04:22 UTC; tsrs commit 00838902cb485153e0256718986416bafd6adf87. TypeScript 7.0.2; TypeScript reference b85298b6a81f772d080b0455de0ca9d744cd6fd6.
